subject: 花戏楼 · 院内中央戏台
author: 三猎
source_note: 三猎2016年实拍两角度；图版只绘院内中央戏台与台下通道，保留四根前柱、栏杆、挂落与琉璃屋脊，省略左右看楼、铭文与树木。主体是1676年增建戏台，不是1656年始建关帝庙的砖雕山门。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single fine-line architectural illustration for heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: borrow its delicate slightly organic thin black contours, generous unmarked white space and restrained density. Images 2 and 3 are SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY, real photographs of the Huaxilou (花戏楼) central opera stage inside Daguandi Temple in Bozhou, Anhui. Draw ONLY the projecting central opera-stage pavilion, not the brick entrance archway, and not the flanking courtyard galleries. Stage built 1676 and later repaired. Preserve the photographs' raised stage and its rectangular passage underneath, four red timber front columns defining three bays, low openwork front balustrade, intricately carved hanging brackets with pendant lotus forms, the one hip-and-gable tiled roof and its decorated ridge. Image 3 clarifies the hip-and-gable roof's side slope, not a second roof. Draw the stage front at facade level, near straight-on, verticals upright, with just enough minimal side projection to explain the platform. Entire isolated pavilion including base, roof ridge ornaments and corner tips is uncut; centered landscape 1536x1024, about 80% width, broad white margins. If the photos hide detail in shadow or behind foliage, simplify those areas without inventing sculpture.
BLACK INK ONLY on fully OPAQUE flat PURE WHITE #FFFFFF paper, alpha255 everywhere. NO transparent background. All surfaces and openings remain white apart from thin ink contours. No large black fills, shadow, crosshatching, grey shading, paper texture, grain, gradient, vignette, glow or checkerboard. A local script will convert the white paper to transparency afterward. Selective sparse tile and ornament outlines instead of dense uniform detail. Remove trees, people, signs, lamps, neighboring galleries and courtyard scenery. Plaques and column boards are blank: no Chinese characters, captions, lettering, labels, dimensions, watermark, frame or border. Match the STYLE reference's slender lines.
